## 席位核对 — REWORK · repo:objectstack#3 · head 3671d230 · 2026-11-24T13:52Z

L1: REWORK
Head-sha: `3671d23047763cfa0691256d025d55f857845c59`
Reviewer: L1-b (3) (seat 3, area ux-E2).
Tier: not Tier H. This is card #36898's only PR: 14 files, +724/−10 (734 lines, under the 3,000-line per-card line). `check-governed-merges --pr 36983`: not governed.

### Read
- I read the net diff `origin/main...3671d230`, the PR body, card #36898 with claim 7131378183, and dev report 7132860189.
- Check-runs on `3671d230`: 45 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending. `l1-face.mjs --pr 36983`: CLEAN.
- Screenshot `before-publish.png` (orphan commit `e80fcad4`): it shows a 修改时间 column, an em-dash for the code-shipped items, a violet 「AI 的改动未发布」 mark, an amber 「有未发布的改动」 mark, and a localized time on the stored item.

### Checklist
- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #36898`, plus `Part of #36890`. One PR delivers the whole card, so `Fixes` is right.
- **Scope.** New modules `listChangedAt.ts`, `listDraftMarks.ts` and `ListChangedCell.tsx`, each with its own test file. The mount in `ResourceListPage.tsx` is 15 lines. There is a `changed` key in `metadataListState.ts`, the client reader in `metadata-client.ts`, seven en/zh studio keys, and the changeset. There is no `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and no protocol change. `useListOrderedNames.ts` is outside the claim's file list (S2).
- **Item 1, the time column and its sort.** The time is read from `changedAt` keyed by the item's primary key. `readChangedAt` keeps only entries that parse with `GetMetaItemsResponseSchema`, so a missing time stays missing. `compareChangedAt` sorts a missing time last in both directions, and ties sort A to Z by name and then by input order. The `changed` key reaches the URL through `LIST_SORT_KEYS` (decode, encode, and the `SORT_OPTIONS` flatMap that draws `engine.list.sort.changed.{asc,desc}`). `useListOrderedNames` reads the same map and waits while it is unread under `sort=changed`, so ‹ › follow the order the list draws. Met.
- **Item 2, the mark from the existing ledger.** The mark reads `client.listDrafts()` (`/meta/_drafts`, shared via `shareRead`) and filters it to the type with `canonicalMetaUrlType`. It is re-read with `refreshKey` and on `subscribeMetadataRefresh`. A ledger that fails to read marks nothing. No protocol change, and a draft that existed before the change is marked too. Met.
- **Item 3, AI vs person.** `draftMarkKindOf` uses `isAgentDraftSurface` (`copilot` or `mcp`), the same predicate `StudioDraftMark` and the pillars use. It is imported, not copied. Met.
- **Acceptance.**
  - "改一项后时间更新、标记出现；发布后标记消失" is met as the PR body's acceptance notes read it. A live save moves the time. A draft save shows the mark and leaves the time, because `changedAt` is the published row's time and the card rules out a protocol change. Publishing removes the mark and moves the time (screenshot 3).
  - "代码包自带的项时间为空，不报错": met. `EmptyValue` is pinned by the page test.
- **Tests.** There are four new test files, and the page test covers the column, the `?sort=-changed` order, both mark kinds and a no-mark control. Two ablations are recorded with restored blobs.
- **i18n.** The seven keys are in en and zh, and the zh reads naturally. The studio namespace has only those two packs.
- **Changeset.** `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch, `Metadata-protocol: none`. I read it sentence by sentence against the diff and it matches, apart from the declaration line (S1).

### Findings
No must-fix.

- **S1 (should-fix): the declaration should be `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, not `no`.** `MetadataListAnswer` is exported from `@object-ui/data-objectstack`'s entry (`src/index.ts`, the `./metadata-client` type re-export). It now gains an optional `changedAt` member, which `MetadataClient.listResponse` returns. That adds to the published package's public surface. The fleet's precedent for a new public member of a published `@object-ui/*` package is `yes (widening)`: `.changeset/36011-restore-factory-view.md` (adapter method plus `plugin-view` props), and #36846 on this seat. Fix: change the line in the PR body and in `.changeset/36898-list-changed-column.md` to `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, and keep `Metadata-protocol: none` and `patch`. The `yes` then owes a `TIER_DEFAULT` contract review, which I will run on the new head. That change is in prose only.
- **S2 (should-fix): amend the claim's file surface.** `useListOrderedNames.ts` (8 lines) is outside the files claim 7131378183 lists. The edit belongs to the card, since ‹ › must follow `sort=changed`, and the report explains it. The claim still needs a surface amendment comment naming the file, as #36974's amendments 7131602500 and 7133172172 did. This is a comment for the area thread to post; no code change.
- **N1 (nit).** The publish pulse re-reads only the marks. The rows and the time column re-read on `refreshKey`, so with the list still mounted the time moves on the next load, not at the pulse. Publishing from the item page remounts the list, so the acceptance walk is not affected.
- **N2 (nit).** The AI/person split costs one `getDraft` per pending draft of the type on each ledger read. A `refreshKey` bump and a pulse together read it twice. That is fine at today's draft counts. If it ever shows up, a ledger that carries `by` would turn it into one read.
- **N3 (nit).** A bundle row with no member matches any member's draft of that name. This is stated in the body.
- **N4 (nit).** 734 lines against the ~600 guide for an S card, about 335 of them tests. Accepted.
- **N5 (nit).** The fourth bullet of 「维护者速读」 is a bare 「无。」 with no subject.

Delta read owed: L1 on the new head plus a `TIER_DEFAULT` L2 (S1). A push that changes only the PR body, the changeset and the claim comment keeps everything else in this read.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `2cd7485fb38b03b64c2f6396ee2d13fdd405b256`
Local-runs: none

This is the declaration face. The review is owed by the `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line alone. `record-recognisers --template --paths` over the PR's 14 committed paths finds no published schema, no governed path and no narrowing. Claim 7134144803.

Inputs read:
- Card #36898, claim 7131378183 and amendments 7133510031 and 7133794182. `readClause2Line` on 7133794182 gives `declared · yes · widening`.
- Dev report 7132860189.
- The PR body (lines 8–11: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, and the widening sentence).
- The net diff `origin/main...2cd7485f`. `git diff 3671d230 2cd7485f` is the changeset's declaration line alone, so every code file is byte-identical to the head L1 read in 7133485320.
- Check-runs on `2cd7485f`: 45 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed, 0 pending.

Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **J1, `@object-ui/data-objectstack` public surface.** The package is published: no `private`, and an `exports["."]` entry. Its entry re-exports the type `MetadataListAnswer` from `./metadata-client`. That type changes from `{ items } & Pick<GetMetaItemsResponse, 'registrations'>` to `… Pick<…, 'registrations' | 'changedAt'>`, so it gains one optional member. `MetadataClient.listResponse` returns it. This is additive: no member is removed or made required, and `list` is unchanged. It is a widening of the public surface, declared that way.
- **J2, what the client accepts.** `readChangedAt` keeps an entry only when `GetMetaItemsResponseSchema` (the spec's own rule) parses it, one entry at a time. A non-object or array `changedAt` gives no member, and a bad entry is dropped while the others stand. A server that predates #36894 sends none, and the member stays absent, never a stand-in. The client accepts no more than the spec serves, so nothing narrows.
- **J3, the wire.** No server, door or spec file moves. The `changedAt` sibling has been served since PR #36940 (`Metadata-protocol: added` there). This PR only reads it, plus the existing `GET /meta/_drafts` and the strict draft read (`getDraft`), both unchanged.
- **J4, the other packages.** `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, so its new modules and its `LIST_SORT_KEYS` `changed` member are not a published surface. The 7 new keys in `@object-ui/i18n`'s studio namespace follow the #36924 precedent: new studio-namespace keys alone do not move the declaration. They do not change it here.
- **J5, `Metadata-protocol: none`.** Nothing an author writes moves.

### ② Semver level

- The `Clause-②: yes (widening)` line now reads the same on all three carriers: the changeset body, PR body line 8, and claim amendment 7133794182. That matches J1 and the precedent (`.changeset/36011-restore-factory-view.md`; #36846).
- `patch` on `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` is right: a non-protocol widening with `Metadata-protocol: none` ships `patch` (AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist step 3). Not breaking, so no ADR-0087 disposition is owed.
- **F1 (nit).** The changeset says `listResponse` "now returns the list's `changedAt`". It does not name `MetadataListAnswer`, the exported type that carries the widening. The PR body's widening sentence does. This is prose only.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`:** none.
- **Deviations** (the `useListOrderedNames.ts` edit, the ledger read through the list's client, 734 lines): the claim amendments cover the surface, and L1 accepted the rest.
- **`out_of_scope_findings`:** acceptance notes only. A person's draft save does not move the time; a never-published draft has no row; a bundle row without a member matches any member's draft. All are recorded in the PR body.
- **SQL push-down:** no finding. The client builds no join. The per-draft `getDraft` read (L1 N2) is an HTTP fan-out bounded by the type's pending drafts, not a query the server could push down.
- **Author:** the PR's `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no author note is owed.

F1 has no effect on correctness or the contract, so this is the final round.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-36898-list-changed-column`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzhjqviExWpzQMm57Mt`

**VERDICT: PASS**
